title: Finite C¹ partition of unity on a neighbourhood of a compact set, subordinate to locally given open sets
statement: Let N ∈ ℕ, C ⊆ ℝᴺ = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N) compact, and P a property of subsets of ℝᴺ such that every y ∈ C lies in some open set U with P(U). Then there exist p ∈ ℕ, functions ζ_q : ℝᴺ → ℝ (q ∈ Fin p) and an open set O ⊇ C such that Σ_q ζ_q(z) = 1 for every z ∈ O, and for every q: ζ_q is C¹, ζ_q has compact support, and tsupport ζ_q ⊆ U for some U with P(U).
lean_statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (C : Set (Rn N)) (P : Set (Rn N) → Prop), IsCompact C → (∀ y ∈ C, ∃ U : Set (Rn N), IsOpen U ∧ y ∈ U ∧ P U) → ∃ (p : ℕ) (ζ : Fin p → Rn N → ℝ) (O : Set (Rn N)), IsOpen O ∧ C ⊆ O ∧ (∀ z ∈ O, ∑ q, ζ q z = 1) ∧ ∀ q, ContDiff ℝ 1 (ζ q) ∧ HasCompactSupport (ζ q) ∧ ∃ U : Set (Rn N), P U ∧ tsupport (ζ q) ⊆ U
